description: Change the title, description, tags or insert card text (material line, care instructions, warnings) of one of your print shop's products. The change shows at once wherever the product is published, and the answer gives what each changed field was before. Prices and where the product is published are changed on Printlooper. Only products from list_my_products. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

care_instructions.description: Printed on the insert card. At least 40 characters, or null or empty to remove it.

material_label.description: The material line on the insert card, up to 120 characters. null or empty removes it.

tags.description: Replaces the tags the product has

warnings.description: Printed on the insert card. At least 40 characters, or null or empty to remove it.

name: update_my_product
title: Edit one of my products
